Description: Estimated price per cubic meter of irrigation water, based on state-level historical irrigation rates from USDA census data; when state-level data was unavailable, the U.S. mean was used. Prices were converted from dollars per acre-foot to dollars per cubic meter

Estimated price per cubic meter of municipal water, based on historical retail water rates from a 2023 Pacific Northwest National Laboratory report. County-level prices were assigned based on utility location, with state or regional averages used when utility data was unavailable. Prices were converted from dollars per thousand gallons to dollars per cubic meter
